# Turtleand Decentralized Systems Lab

Canonical: https://decentralized.turtleand.com/

The Decentralized Systems Lab is Turtleand's progressive path for understanding blockchain technology from first principles. It focuses on protocols, incentives, custody, security, wallets, contracts, governance, and trade-offs. The surface teaches durable systems literacy rather than price commentary, token promotion, or market timing.

## Learning path

- Foundations: Understand ledgers, consensus, assets, identity, custody, contracts, and governance.
- Architectures: Compare major decentralized systems and the trade-offs they make.
- Experiments: Build small, testnet-first artifacts that make the concepts concrete.
- Agents: Explore how AI agents can interact with decentralized infrastructure under human review.

Main route: https://decentralized.turtleand.com/

## Article index

### Distribution Without One Central Algorithm

A systems explainer on how Mastodon content travels through followers, boosts, hashtags, federation, visibility settings, and moderation instead of one global ranking algorithm.

URL: https://decentralized.turtleand.com/topics/distribution-without-one-central-algorithm/

### Bitcoin Is Heavy Because It Bundles Trust

A four-layer explanation of why blockchains bundle many trust problems together, while newer tools split trust into smaller specialized systems.

URL: https://decentralized.turtleand.com/topics/bitcoin-blockchain-trust-unbundling/

### Swapping Legacy sUSD on Optimism

A practical account of handling legacy Synthetix sUSD tokens on Optimism, including failed swaps, a smart-account workaround, and the resulting custody lessons.

URL: https://decentralized.turtleand.com/topics/swapping-legacy-susd-optimism/
